concepts.gloss_en: Holy boldness/audacity (azut of holiness); the sanctified form of brazenness needed to receive Torah and draw close to the tzaddikim

reason_for_human: All 13 occurrences carry identical vocalization (עַזּוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה) and identical meaning throughout LM 22 and LM 30 — 'holy boldness' contrasted repeatedly with עזות דסטרא אחרא/עזות הגוף. The only variant, לעזות דקדשׁה, is the same phrase with a prepositional ל prefix (inflectional, not a homograph), so it merges cleanly.
